scope: Proposition 7.14 (Uniform global reflexive index) of the manuscript “Conditional good minimal models for compact Kähler fourfolds” (preprints/Conditional-good-minimal-models-for-compact-Kahler-fourfolds-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 eebddaadef6935c3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 57. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix 0 < ϵ ≤ 1 and an integer n ≥ 0. For effective rational klt threefold pairs on normal globally strongly Q-factorial compact Kähler spaces, suppose every discrepancy is at least ϵ, at most n exceptional places have discrepancy at most one, and every exceptional discrepancy greater than one is at least 1 + ϵ. There is an integer I(n, ϵ) > 0 such that F[I(n,ϵ)] is invertible for every global rank-one reflexive sheaf F on each such space.
